name: SqlPackageInstaller
description: Installs a specific version of SqlPackage from the internet or the tools cache and adds it to the PATH. Use this task to change the version of SqlPackage used in subsequent tasks.
author: PedroC88

inputs.name: versionSpec
inputs.label: Version Spec
inputs.helpMarkDown: Version range or exact version of SqlPackage to use. For information about valid version ranges, see [SqlPackage releases](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/tools/sqlpackage/sqlpackage-release-notes). Use 'latest' for the most recent version.

inputs.name: checkLatest
inputs.label: Check for Latest Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select this option to check online for the latest available version that satisfies the version spec. This is typically false unless you have a specific scenario to always use the absolute latest version.

inputs.name: installDirectory
inputs.label: Install Directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Specify where SqlPackage will be installed. If not specified, SqlPackage will be installed to a directory under the tools cache.

messages.ToolNotFoundMicrosoftUrl: Unable to find SqlPackage version '%s' for platform %s and architecture %s. Check that the version is valid and try again. If the issue persists, there may be an issue with the tool download URL. Please report this issue.
messages.ToolNotFoundInCache: SqlPackage version '%s' not found in cache.
messages.ToolFoundInCache: Found SqlPackage version '%s' in cache at %s.
messages.SuccessfullyInstalled: SqlPackage version '%s' has been installed successfully.
messages.ExactVersionNotRecommended: Specifying an exact version is not recommended. Consider using a version range instead.
